name: veloz-monorepo
description: Veloz.js - A blazing fast reactive frontend framework

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p type-tests && tsc -p type-tests/templates.tsconfig.json
scripts.release: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" publish --access public
